title: Phased site safety plans.
officialText: Multiple layouts of the site safety features enumerated in section 28-110.1 may be submitted at any time during construction operations to show phased site safety designs consistent with the phase of anticipated work. ARTICLE 111 TEMPORARY STRUCTURES AND USES
